items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 16 at 6:21PM EST until November 16 at 9:00PM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Oregon Inlet to Cape Lookout.

* WHEN...Until 9 PM EST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
